title: Megapot Club — Independent community interface
description: An independent Megapot community interface for tickets, draw results, winnings and wallet actions. Static and MIT licensed.
stale: Data may be out of date
rpcUnavailable: Could not refresh from Base. The last verified snapshot is still shown.
previewDescription: A home for your numbers and draw details.
previewNote: Save numbers locally. Ticket checkout is not enabled.
invalidAddress: Enter a valid 0x address with 40 hexadecimal characters.
accountNotice: Connect to propose actions in your wallet. Each transaction requires your review and approval.
resultsDescription: Latest numbers, with scheduled draw times shown in your time zone and UTC.
recentOnly: Showing {count} recent drawings. This is not a complete history.
dataNote: All drawing values in this snapshot were read at the same Base block. A matching runtime hash is a compatibility check, not a security audit.
aboutDescription: Megapot Club is an independently built and run community app for the {megapot} internet lottery protocol on {base}, an {ethereum} Layer 2.
transparentDetail: Public draw results and published smart contracts let anyone check the underlying data. No account is required.
portableDetail: Static files, bundled fonts, and direct Base RPC reads. The same build can be hosted on the web or on IPFS.
openSourceDetail: Original application code, independently maintained and licensed under MIT.
rpcHelp: Base RPC endpoints are tried in order. Settings stay in this browser.
rpcLabel: HTTPS RPC endpoints · one per line
rpcPrivacy: RPC providers receive your requests and IP address. URLs in a static app are public; use browser-safe credentials only.
rpcConfig: Enter between 1 and 4 public HTTPS RPC URLs, one per line.
copyFailed: Copy unavailable. Select the address to copy it.
privacyDetail: No analytics. Preferences, drafts and receipts stay in your browser. Public data comes from external providers; wallet connections use your chosen wallet provider.
lookupFailed: Could not load tickets. Check your RPC settings and try again.
verifiablySecureDetail: A thin, open-source web app that runs entirely in your browser, with no Club backend. You can inspect its code and verify what it does.
